title: Secure first confirmed partner / sibling-project consumer
context: The catalog's per-task delivery need stays unproven until a named advocacy org, repository, or sibling-project owner confirms they will adopt, host, cite, or consume it. This task converts outreach (outreach-008) into a confirmed consumer and updates that partner's tasks to verifiedNeed: true. Until then all tasks remain verifiedNeed false. No partner is yet secured, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Secure and record one confirmed partner/consumer for the catalog, with the adoption mechanism documented.
acceptanceCriteria: A named advocacy org / repository / sibling-project owner confirms they will adopt, host, cite, or consume the catalog.
Adoption/consumption mechanism documented (index link / repo PR / sibling-project import).
Tasks for that partner updated to verifiedNeed: true with requestor set.
output: docs/partners.md recording the confirmed partner and adoption mechanism
